title: The comeback nobody could call

market.question: Will Donald Trump win the 2024 US Presidential Election?
market.rulesSummary: YES if Donald J. Trump wins the 2024 US presidential election. AP, Fox News and NBC must all call the same winner; if they had not agreed by January 20, 2025, the inauguration determined resolution.

events.title: A New York jury finds Trump guilty on 34 felony counts
claims: The jury returned guilty verdicts on 34 counts.
confounds: Jury deliberation and public anticipation preceded the cutoff.
Legal consequences, fundraising, and partisan reactions may overlap.
events.unresolved: Exact first-public verdict time is not asserted; the retained CNN bracket is an upper bound.

events.title: A gunman shoots Trump at a Pennsylvania rally; he survives
claims: The July 13 Butler rally shooting occurred and Trump survived.
confounds: The cutoff follows the shooting and several live reports.
Biden-candidacy uncertainty and the approaching Republican convention overlap the wider period.
events.unresolved: Earliest public reporting time is not asserted; the CNN live-program ending is an upper bound.
events.editorialIssue: Repeated Butler event from Biden #001; different contract perspective does not eliminate answer-recall risk.

events.title: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. suspends his campaign and says he will support Trump
claims: Kennedy suspended his campaign and announced support for Trump.
confounds: The decision was discussed before the speech.
The Democratic National Convention ended the previous night; subsequent rally coverage overlaps the response period.
events.unresolved: Exact first-public announcement time is not asserted; the CNN segment ending is an upper bound.

events.title: Harris and Trump meet for their first presidential debate
claims: Harris and Trump participated in their first presidential debate together.
confounds: The debate was a long live broadcast with information arriving throughout.
Post-debate commentary and endorsements overlap the response windows.
events.unresolved: First-broadcast end and earliest transcript availability remain unresolved; later page edits are not backdated.

events.title: The final Iowa Poll reports Harris ahead of Trump, 47% to 44%
claims: The final Des Moines Register/Mediacom poll reported Harris 47% and Trump 44% among likely voters.
confounds: The state result is not a national forecast and the finding was within the reported margin of error.
The delayed window reaches November 5 election-night information.
events.unresolved: The publisher page returned HTTP 403 during capture; the CNN transcript is retained, while the first-public release time remains an upper bound.

ending.text: The Associated Press called the presidential race for Trump at 05:34 EST on November 6, 2024. The provider's settlement rule required the named resolution sources.
